items.text: Don't control the outcome. Just let go. That's enough.
Set down "I hope it turns out this way," too.
You don't need to know what will fill the space you've just made.
I don't know. And so, I can let it be.
Today's portion is released. The rest, when it replays again.
The quiet you just found is where you really live.
No rush. Like breathing, there will be a next time.
The outside doesn't have to change right away. The inside is already a little lighter.
Peace is already starting, right here.
Expectation is a memory too. Now that it's released, there's room.
